description: This file is a shell script used for platform-specific upgrade operations in an OpenWrt-based system. It defines functions to check images, perform upgrades, and copy configurations based on different board types.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is compatible with the current platform based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade, selecting the method based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the configuration to the device based on the board type.
